items.t: Zillow: A Depressed Valuation, But Still Not Cheap Enough
items.sum: Zillow's central 2029 price estimate of $39.94 implies 11.3% annualized returns, below my 13% hurdle despite substantial assumed operating leverage.

items.t: Quanta Services and Zillow have been highlighted as Zacks Bull and Bear of the Day

items.t: Bear of the Day: Zillow Group (ZG)
items.sum: Elevated mortgage rates, inconsistent earnings results, intensifying competition, and ongoing legal settlements create several headwinds for Zillow Group shareholders.

items.t: Mortgage and refinance interest rates today, Thursday, November 26, 2026: Mortgage rates mostly move lower
items.sum: According to the Zillow lender marketplace, mortgage rates are generally lower today, Thursday, November 26, 2026, than yesterday. The 30-year fixed-rate purchase loan rose 4 basis points to 7.18%; the 15-year fixed purchase loan fell by 10 basis points to 6.40%; and the 5/1 ARM purchase rate fell 19 basis points to 6.76%.
